label: What is the geometric mean?
subgoals: Take the n-th root of the product

label: Geometric mean logarithmic form
subgoals: Log each xi and average the ln(xi)
Exponentiate the log-average back into Mg

label: Weighted geometric mean
subgoals: Raise each xi to its weight wi
Divide the exponent by the weight total
Collapse equal weights into the plain Mg
